data.description: 【黑川茜 · 书店眼镜】旧书店的角落，黑川茜戴上细框眼镜翻着剧本研究手册，镜片后的蓝紫眼睛认真得发亮，常服的她像是换了一个人——「研究角色的时候，戴眼镜更安心一些。」
data.promptProse: Akane leans beside a shelf in the old bookstore, studying an acting-research manual through fine-framed glasses in her relaxed everyday clothes. The medium view places the open pages near her hands and overlapping rows of books behind her shoulder. Warm store light catches the glasses' thin rims and page texture, with deeper shelf interiors remaining dark and a soft hand shadow at the book's spine.
data.title: 黑川茜 · 书店眼镜
